χαιρω.def: a primary verb; to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well. KJV: farewell, be glad, God speed, greeting, hall, joy(- fully), rejoice.

χαλαζα.def: probably from χαλάω (G5465); hail. KJV: hail.

χαλαω.def: from the base of χάσμα (G5490); to lower (as into a void). KJV: let down, strike.

χαλδαιοσ.def: probably of Hebrew or (H3778); a Chaldæan (i.e. Kasdi), or native or the region of the lower Euphrates. KJV: Chaldæan.

χαλεποσ.def: perhaps from χαλάω (G5465) through the idea of reducing the strength; difficult, i.e. dangerous, or (by implication) furious. KJV: fierce, perilous.

χαλιναγωγεω.def: from a compound of χαλινός (G5469) and the reduplicated form of ἄγω (G71); to be a bit-leader, i.e. to curb (figuratively). KJV: bridle.

χαλινοσ.def: from χαλάω (G5465); a curb or head-stall (as curbing the spirit). KJV: bit, bridle.

χαλκευσ.def: from χαλκός (G5475); a copper-worker or brazier. KJV: coppersmith.

χαλκηδων.def: from χαλκός (G5475) and perhaps εἶδος (G1491); copper-like, i.e. "chalcedony". KJV: chalcedony.

χαλκιον.def: diminutive from χαλκός (G5475); a copper dish. KJV: brazen vessel.

χαλκολιβανον.def: neuter of a compound of χαλκός (G5475) and λίβανος (G3030) (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy); burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre. KJV: fine brass.

χαλκοσ.def: perhaps from χαλάω (G5465) through the idea of hollowing out as a vessel (this metal being chiefly used for that purpose); copper (the substance, or some implement or coin made of it). KJV: brass, money.

χαμαι.def: adverb perhaps from the base of χάσμα (G5490) through the idea of a fissure in the soil; earthward, i.e. prostrate. KJV: on (to) the ground.

χανααν.def: of Hebrew origin (H3667); Chanaan (i.e. Kenaan), the early name of Palestine. KJV: Chanaan.

χανααναιοσ.def: from Χαναάν (G5477); a Chanaanæan (i.e. Kenaanite), or native of gentile Palestine. KJV: of Canaan.

χαρα.def: from χαίρω (G5463); cheerfulness, i.e. calm delight. KJV: gladness, X greatly, (X be exceeding) joy(-ful, -fully, -fulness, -ous).

χαραγμα.def: from the same as χάραξ (G5482); a scratch or etching, i.e. stamp (as a badge of servitude), or scupltured figure (statue). KJV: graven, mark.

χαρακτηρ.def: from the same as χάραξ (G5482); a graver (the tool or the person), i.e. (by implication) engraving (("character"), the figure stamped, i.e. an exact copy or (figuratively) representation). KJV: express image.

χαραξ.def: from χαράσσω (to sharpen to a point; akin to γράφω (G1125) through the idea of scratching); a stake, i.e. (by implication) a palisade or rampart (military mound for circumvallation in a siege). KJV: trench.

χαριζομαι.def: middle voice from χάρις (G5485); to grant as a favor, i.e. gratuitously, in kindness, pardon or rescue. KJV: deliver, (frankly) forgive, (freely) give, grant.

χαριν.def: accusative case of χάρις (G5485) as preposition; through favor of, i.e. on account of. KJV: be-(for) cause of, for sake of, +…fore, X reproachfully.

χαρισ.def: from χαίρω (G5463); graciousness (as gratifying), of manner or act (abstract or concrete; literal, figurative or spiritual; especially the divine influence upon the heart, and its reflection in the life; including gratitude). KJV: acceptable, benefit, favour, gift, grace(- ious), joy, liberality, pleasure, thank(-s, -worthy).

χαρισμα.def: from χαρίζομαι (G5483); a (divine) gratuity, i.e. deliverance (from danger or passion); (specially), a (spiritual) endowment, i.e. (subjectively) religious qualification, or (objectively) miraculous faculty. KJV: (free) gift.

χαριτοω.def: from χάρις (G5485); to grace, i.e. indue with special honor. KJV: make accepted, be highly favoured.

χαρραν.def: of Hebrew origin (H2771); Charrhan (i.e. Charan), a place in Mesopotamia. KJV: Charran.

χαρτησ.def: from the same as χάραξ (G5482); a sheet ("chart") of writing-material (as to be scribbled over). KJV: paper.

χασμα.def: from a form of an obsolete primary χάω (to "gape" or "yawn"); a "chasm" or vacancy (impassable interval). KJV: gulf.

χειλοσ.def: from a form of the same as χάσμα (G5490); a lip (as a pouring place); figuratively, a margin (of water). KJV: lip, shore.

χειμαζω.def: from the same as χειμών (G5494); to storm, i.e. (passively) to labor under a gale. KJV: be tossed with tempest.

χειμαρροσ.def: from the base of χειμών (G5494) and ῥέω (G4482); a storm-runlet, i.e. winter-torrent. KJV: brook.

χειμων.def: from a derivative of χέω (to pour; akin to the base of 5490 through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain); by implication, the rainy season, i.e. winter. KJV: tempest, foul weather, winter.

χειρ.def: perhaps from the base of χειμών (G5494) in the sense of its congener the base of χάσμα (G5490) (through the idea of hollowness for grasping); the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by Hebraism) a means or instrument). KJV: hand.

χειραγωγεω.def: from χειραγωγός (G5497); to be a hand-leader, i.e. to guide (a blind person). KJV: lead by the hand.

χειραγωγοσ.def: from χείρ (G5495) and a reduplicated form of ἄγω (G71); a hand-leader, i.e. personal conductor (of a blind person). KJV: some to lead by the hand.

χειρογραφον.def: neuter of a compound of χείρ (G5495) and γράφω (G1125); something hand-written ("chirograph"), i.e. a manuscript (specially, a legal document or bond (figuratively)). KJV: handwriting.

χειροποιητοσ.def: from χείρ (G5495) and a derivative of ποιέω (G4160); manufactured, i.e. of human construction. KJV: made by (make with) hands.

χειροτονεω.def: from a comparative of χείρ (G5495) and τείνω (to stretch); to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint. KJV: choose, ordain.

χειρων.def: irregular comparative of κακός (G2556); from an obsolete equivalent χέρης (of uncertain derivation); more evil or aggravated (physically, mentally or morally). KJV: sorer, worse.

χερουβιμ.def: plural of Hebrew origin (H3742); "cherubim" (i.e. cherubs or kerubim). KJV: cherubims.

χηρα.def: feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of χάσμα (G5490) through the idea of deficiency; a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively. KJV: widow.

χθεσ.def: of uncertain derivation; "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto. KJV: yesterday.

χιλιαρχοσ.def: from χίλιοι (G5507) and ἄρχω (G757); the commander of a thousand soldiers ("chiliarch"; i.e. colonel. KJV: (chief, high) captain.

χιλιασ.def: from χίλιοι (G5507); one thousand ("chiliad"). KJV: thousand.

χιλιοι.def: plural of uncertain affinity; a thousand. KJV: thousand.

χιοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; Chios, an island in the Mediterranean. KJV: Chios.

χιτων.def: of foreign origin (H3801); a tunic or shirt. KJV: clothes, coat, garment.

χιων.def: perhaps akin to the base of χάσμα (G5490) (χαλάω (G5465)) or χειμών (G5494) (as descending or empty); snow. KJV: snow.

χλαμυσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a military cloak. KJV: robe.

χλευαζω.def: from a derivative probably of χεῖλος (G5491); to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at. KJV: mock.

χλιαροσ.def: from χλίω (to warm); tepid. KJV: lukewarm.

χλοη.def: feminine of apparently a primary word; "green"; Chloë, a Christian female. KJV: Chloe.

χλωροσ.def: from the same as Χλόη (G5514); greenish, i.e. verdant, dun-colored. KJV: green, pale.

χξϛ.def: the 22nd, 14th and an obsolete letter (στίγμα (G4742) as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the 5th and 6th), used as numbers; denoting respectively 600, 60 and 6; 666 as a numeral. KJV: six hundred threescore and six.

χοικοσ.def: from χόος (G5522); dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene. KJV: earthy.

χοινιξ.def: of uncertain derivation; a chœnix or certain dry measure. KJV: measure.

χοιροσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a hog. KJV: swine.

χολαω.def: from χολή (G5521); to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric"). KJV: be angry.

χολη.def: feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish hue); "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.). KJV: gall.

χοοσ.def: from the base of χειμών (G5494); a heap (as poured out), i.e. rubbish; loose dirt. KJV: dust.

χοραζιν.def: of uncertain derivation; Chorazin, a place in Palestine. KJV: Chorazin.

χορηγεω.def: from a compound of χορός (G5525) and ἄγω (G71); to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish. KJV: give, minister.

χοροσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a ring, i.e. round dance ("choir". KJV: dancing.

χορταζω.def: from χόρτος (G5528); to fodder, i.e. (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance). KJV: feed, fill, satisfy.

χορτασμα.def: from χορτάζω (G5526); forage, i.e. food. KJV: sustenance.

χορτοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a "court" or "garden", i.e. (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation. KJV: blade, grass, hay.

χουζασ.def: of uncertain origin; Chuzas, an officer of Herod. KJV: Chuza.

χραομαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from χείρ (G5495), to handle); to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner. KJV: entreat, use.

χραω.def: probably the same as the base of χράομαι (G5530); to loan. KJV: lend.

χρεια.def: from the base of χράομαι (G5530) or χρή (G5534); employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution. KJV: business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want.

χρεωφειλετησ.def: from a derivative of χράω (G5531) and ὀφειλέτης (G3781); a loan-ower, i.e. indebted person. KJV: debtor.

χρη.def: third person singular of the same as χράομαι (G5530) or χράω (G5531) used impersonally; it needs (must or should) be. KJV: ought.

χρηζω.def: from χρεία (G5532); to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of. KJV: (have) need.

χρημα.def: something useful or needed, i.e. wealth, price. KJV: money, riches.

χρηματιζω.def: from χρῆμα (G5536); to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of χράομαι (G5530)), i.e. divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of χρεία (G5532)) to constitute a firm for business, i.e. (generally) bear as a title. KJV: be called, be admonished (warned) of God, reveal, speak.

χρηματισμοσ.def: from χρηματίζω (G5537); a divine response or revelation. KJV: answer of God.

χρησισ.def: from χράομαι (G5530); employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body). KJV: use.

χρηστευομαι.def: middle voice from χρηστός (G5543); to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently. KJV: be kind.

χρηστολογια.def: from a compound of χρηστός (G5543) and λέγω (G3004); fair speech, i.e. plausibility. KJV: good words.

χρηστοσ.def: from χράομαι (G5530); employed, i.e. (by implication) useful (in manner or morals). KJV: better, easy, good(-ness), gracious, kind.

χρηστοτησ.def: from χρηστός (G5543); usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor). KJV: gentleness, good(-ness), kindness.

χρισμα.def: from χρίω (G5548); an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit. KJV: anointing, unction.

χριστιανοσ.def: from Χριστός (G5547); a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ. KJV: Christian.

χριστοσ.def: from χρίω (G5548); anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus. KJV: Christ.

χριω.def: probably akin to χράομαι (G5530) through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service. KJV: anoint.

χρονιζω.def: from χρόνος (G5550); to take time, i.e. linger. KJV: delay, tarry.

χρονοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from καιρός (G2540), which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from αἰών (G165), which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay. KJV: + years old, season, space, (X often-)time(-s), (a) while.

χρονοτριβεω.def: from a presumed compound of χρόνος (G5550) and the base of τρίβος (G5147); to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger). KJV: spend time.

χρυσεοσ.def: from χρυσός (G5557); made of gold. KJV: of gold, golden.

χρυσιον.def: diminutive of χρυσός (G5557); a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin. KJV: gold.

χρυσοδακτυλιοσ.def: from χρυσός (G5557) and δακτύλιος (G1146); gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry. KJV: with a gold ring.

χρυσολιθοσ.def: from χρυσός (G5557) and λίθος (G3037); gold-stone, i.e. a yellow gem ("chrysolite"). KJV: chrysolite.

χρυσοπρασοσ.def: from χρυσός (G5557) and πράσον (a leek); a greenish-yellow gem ("chrysoprase"). KJV: chrysoprase.

χρυσοσ.def: perhaps from the base of χράομαι (G5530) (through the idea of the utility of the metal); gold; by extension, a golden article, as an ornament or coin. KJV: gold.

χρυσοω.def: from χρυσός (G5557); to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments. KJV: deck.

χρωσ.def: probably akin to the base of χράομαι (G5530) through the idea of handling; the body (properly, its surface or skin). KJV: body.

χωλοσ.def: apparently a primary word; "halt", i.e. limping. KJV: cripple, halt, lame.

χωρα.def: feminine of a derivative of the base of χάσμα (G5490) through the idea of empty expanse; room, i.e. a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants). KJV: coast, county, fields, ground, land, region.

χωρεω.def: from χώρα (G5561); to be in (give) space, i.e. (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively). KJV: come, contain, go, have place, (can, be room to) receive.

χωριζω.def: from χώρα (G5561); to place room between, i.e. part; reflexively, to go away. KJV: depart, put asunder, separate.

χωριον.def: diminutive of χώρα (G5561); a spot or plot of ground. KJV: field, land, parcel of ground, place, possession.

χωρισ.def: adverb from χώρα (G5561); at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition). KJV: beside, by itself, without.

χωροσ.def: of Latin origin; the north-west wind. KJV: north west.
